title: elionurus nuttallii
intro: Elionurus nuttallii, commonly known as Wild Indigo Grass, is a species of grass native to North America. The health benefits of Elionurus nuttallii include its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Elionurus nuttallii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
